summary: АЛХААЧ MVP first-run smoke test. Backend: 31/31 pytest cases PASSED covering auth (invalid session_id 401, /auth/me with/without bearer), profile PATCH validation (name 2-16, goal 4000-20000, hex color, notifications), steps sync 14-day batch + overwrite + flag>60k, manual entry validation (14-day window, 200k cap), summary shape, group create with 6-char code from allowed charset (no O/0/I/1/L), preview valid + invalid Mongolian message, join, group detail member view, group detail 403 for non-member (privacy check confirmed), rotate code (owner-only, old code invalidated), remove member rules (owner cannot be removed 409, non-owner cannot remove others 403, self-leave works), delete group owner-only, join-fail rate limit hitting 429 after 5 attempts. Frontend web preview verified via injected token: login screen renders logo/character/Google button, home shows character stage + mono today steps + progress + Өчигдөр/7 хоног/Жин cards + manual-entry button, manual modal opens, filling and saving updates today's steps and shows 'Алхалт хадгалагдлаа' toast, journal tab renders 7-day bar chart + Өчигдөр↔Өнөөдөр delta + 30-day weight curve, groups tab lists 'Тест бүлэг' with mini weight axis and Бүлэг үүсгэх / Кодоор нэгдэх buttons, /join renders 6-cell code input with Нэгдэх button, profile tab shows name field, 6 color chips, goal stepper, notification switches, theme chips, Гарах, Данс устгах. Deprecated packages check: none of expo-av / expo-barcode-scanner / expo-background-fetch are used (package.json uses expo-camera, expo-audio would need verify — steps use expo-sensors Pedometer which is fine).

ui_bugs.issue: No testID on progress bar element; recommended `progress-bar`
Missing testIDs `weight-card` and `weight-axis` (visible in UI but not testable programmatically)
Modal, input, and save button lack testIDs (`manual-steps-modal`, `manual-steps-input`, `manual-steps-save`). Modal opens & save works via text/query but harder to test.

Group card row lacks testID (e.g., `group-card-{gid}`); Playwright get_by_text('Тест бүлэг') click timed out — link/pressable may not be text-directly-clickable. Group detail navigation should be verified once testID is added.
Theme mode chips (Систем/Гэрэл/Харанхуй) lack testIDs; automated dark-mode toggle could not be verified.

issues: Rendered date reads 'August 20' — English month name; consider Mongolian month/day format to match all-Mongolian UI spec.

action_items: Add missing testIDs on: progress bar, weight card, weight axis, manual steps modal + input + save button, group card row (with group_id), theme mode chips.
Consider localizing the header date on /home to Mongolian (e.g., '8-р сарын 20') for full Mongolian UI consistency.
Verify group-detail screen (weight axis, member list, owner-only Код солих / Бүлэг устгах, member Бүлгээс гарах) once group card testID exists — backend endpoint already fully covered by pytest.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is 677 lines — approaching the 700-line threshold; consider splitting into auth/steps/groups modules soon.
process_weights caps iterations at 120 which is fine; last_processed_date fallback to yesterday when parse fails is safe.
MongoDB _id is uniformly excluded in queries — good.
Rate-limit uses join_fails collection with TTL index (1200s) matching the 10-min window.

success_rate.frontend: ~85% (login, home, manual entry, journal, groups list, join, profile all render & core interactions work; group-detail nav + dark-mode toggle unverified due to missing testIDs)

seed_data_creation: Used pre-seeded users user_test000001 / user_test000002 and their bearer tokens from /app/memory/test_credentials.md. Pytest created & cleaned up two transient groups (TEST_бүлэг_pytest, TEST_private_grp). Rate-limit test locked user_test000002 out of join for ~10 min — expected.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend fully covered by /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — reuse for regression. Note: TestRateLimit locks user_test000002 for 10 min; if re-running quickly, either flush db.join_fails or expect the rate-limit case only. For frontend, add testIDs to items listed under action_items to enable end-to-end coverage of group detail + theme switch.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no bugs to root-cause; only minor testID coverage gaps identified.
